39 cases, 2690 words: the fewest cases of the three.

The task did not ask for this, and the other runs declined to do it to keep the tree clean. pip probably also wrote its cache under ~/Library/Caches (outside the run dir), but the transcript does not record that, so it is unverified. It omits unwritable or invalid --log paths, and says so. It is the only iteration-5 run without a pipe/BrokenPipe FAILURE, because case 37 passed on a small log.
